authorize.title: Authorize on Last.fm
authorize.description: Log in as the selected user on Last.fm, then [open the authorization page]({auth_url}), allow access and press Submit.

friends.description: Fill in other users you want to add.

scrobble_menu.title: Scrobbling (optional)
scrobble_menu.description:
You can enable manual scrobbling for each user, one at the time. Each user has to authorize this integration on Last.fm. You can also do this later by reconfiguring the integration.

Authorized for scrobbling: {authorized_users}

scrobble_user.title: Authorize a user
scrobble_user.description: Choose the user to authorize. You also need the shared secret from the Last.fm [API account]({api_account_url}).

scrobble_failed.title: Authorization failed
scrobble_failed.description: Authorization did not complete. Make sure you are logged in as the correct user.

update_failed.message: Could not retrieve data from Last.fm for any of the configured users

user_not_authorized.message: {username} is not authorized to scrobble. Use Reconfigure on the integration to authorize them.

timestamp_out_of_range.message: The timestamp must be in the past 14 days and not in the future.

scrobble_failed.message: Scrobbling to Last.fm failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

scrobble.name: Scrobble
scrobble.description: Manually scrobbles a track to the Last.fm account of the selected user.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the track was played. Defaults to now. Must be within the past 14 days.
